long_biography.plain_text:
McGregor Fashion Group began with a rights deal. In 1993, Ben Kolff and his partners acquired European distribution rights to the American sportswear name and built a Dutch fashion house around it. A stock-market listing followed six years later, with Gaastra and Adam Menswear later broadening the group beyond its core label.

Kolff remained a major shareholder and commercial executive as the company combined brand ownership, licensing and an expanding shop network. His interest in sailing also shaped Gaastra's public identity: he raced from childhood and used regattas as both a personal pursuit and a setting for customer relationships. After McGregor's 2016 insolvency, he joined fellow shareholders in financing a rescue, but the business failed again the following year.
long_biography.html:
McGregor Fashion Group began with a rights deal. In 1993, Ben Kolff and his partners acquired European distribution rights to the American sportswear name and built a Dutch fashion house around it. A stock-market listing followed six years later, with Gaastra and Adam Menswear later broadening the group beyond its core label.

Kolff remained a major shareholder and commercial executive as the company combined brand ownership, licensing and an expanding shop network. His interest in sailing also shaped Gaastra's public identity: he raced from childhood and used regattas as both a personal pursuit and a setting for customer relationships. After McGregor's 2016 insolvency, he joined fellow shareholders in financing a rescue, but the business failed again the following year.
